## Description

/patients/merge: side-by-side comparison (name, DOB, sex, mobile, ABHA/EID, visits, allergies) with actions Not the same person / Request clinician approval. Merge executes only after approval; when both records have clinical data (from P2 on) a second approver (clinician) is required. Merge keeps both originals, maps the loser to the survivor and is reversible.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** "Not the same person" closes the request and suppresses the same pair from future suggestions.
- [ ] **AC2.** A merge without the required approver(s) is impossible (server-side), and approvals are audited.
- [ ] **AC3.** After merge, searching either MRN finds the surviving record; appointments and identifiers move; the merge can be undone by an admin within the retention period.
- [ ] **AC4.** Merge history is visible on the patient record.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
